title: Golibaje
howToPrepare:
Ingredients:

    all purpose flour

    curd

    sugar

    ginger

    green chilli

    salt

    baking soda pinch

    how to prepare:
    In a mixing bowl add all purpose flour, curd, salt, ginger, green chillies, coriander leaves
    sugar and salt to taste add water and mix and fry in deep frying pan.
